name: The Hull Field
description: Act 2, chapter `the-proof` (STORY.md §16): the `hull-field` mission on Ash. A flat, dark, airless basin ringed by low cratered hills. North of the Core three long parallel rows of hulls (wrecks, all facing the same way): `row-accord` nearest, then `row-kindred`, then `row-engram` (six hulls a row: 18 of the 33, the most a region can hold; salvage falls off along each row). At the east end of the Accord row, an empty levelled berth: `newest-hull`, with our probe's serial, guarded by relic grid `berth` (four sentinels and a node: earlier Accords, which stand down at the handshake). South-west, the oldest two hulls lie in a pit (`deep-hulls`) over an isotope seam. No life, no packs (open spawn, 30 min grace). Hook: `thirty-three`. Still needs: the three paints on the hulls (Accord, Kindred, Engram: wrecks have no paint field yet), the remaining 15 hulls if the wreck limit rises, and the expedition package.
